items: 【6.99 HD+ Android 15】This is an Android Cell phone with a large screen, 6.99" HD Screen, This unlocked Android 16 I26 Ultra phone is equipped with a 108MP main camera and a 68MP front facing camera, better recording a beautiful life and showcasing your beauty. And it has facial recognition and screen fingerprint unlocking functions, which effectively protect your privacy.
【7000mAh Long lasting battery】With the 7000mAh big battery and own battery saving technology, I26 Ultra smartphone unlocked can confidently last a full day of medium-to-heavy use without charging.

【Snapdragon8s Gen4】Snapdragon8s Gen4 with 16GB+512GB of memory is enough for you to use any application simultaneously, including watching movies and playing games. easily store your favorite music, videos, and pictures, and easily improve the cost-effectiveness of your phone.

【Dual SIM and Global Band 5G Phone】Dual SIM & 2 Card Slots, I26 Ultra Smartphone adopts 2 card slot design (SIM/TF card holder sharing), supports two 5G SIM cards. The machine adopts 5G smartphone with fast transmission speed, short latency, high positioning accuracy, and wide link, allowing users to feel a more advanced experience. The Smart cellphone allows you to flexibly change carriers and choose your own data plan.
